introHtml: Resealable round wood cased pencils combine the classic appeal of wooden pencils with a reusable plastic tube that keeps the pencil safe and extends its life. Ideal for trade shows or school kits, these pencils allow recipients to store them after use, reducing waste. The resealable feature also provides extra space for your logo or message, giving you more branding real estate than a standard pencil. Choose from multiple imprint colors to match your brand.
